verdict.rationale: Flagsmith is a feature-flag/SaaS platform, not an agent or AI host — it has no runtime that would consume external MCP servers' tools. The evidence instead shows Flagsmith ships an official MCP *server* (docs-17, docs-29, probe-3, probe-rt-1) so other AI agents can call Flagsmith's own API, which is the opposite role and belongs to a separate 'serves an MCP server' story, not this client-side axis.
